ui.lib.arcade.note.2048: Yi amfani da maɓallan kibiya ko ka goge yatsa don matsar da dukkan tayal. Tayal biyu masu lamba ɗaya suna haɗuwa idan sun taɓa juna. Yi tayal da ya yi daidai da manufa don wuce matakin; idan babu tayal da zai iya motsawa, ka yi rashin nasara.
ui.lib.arcade.note.blocks: Juya kuma ka ajiye guda masu faɗuwa don cike layukan kwance; layukan da suka cika suna ɓacewa. ← → matsawa, ↑ juyawa, ↓ sauka da sauri, Sarari yana jefawa nan take, P tsayawa. Share adadin layukan da ake buƙata don wuce matakin; idan guda sun kai sama, ka yi rashin nasara.
ui.lib.arcade.note.breakout: Matsar da linzami, ja yatsanka a kan filin ko yi amfani da ← → don jagorantar allo da kiyaye ƙwallo a wasa. Fasa dukkan bulo don wuce matakin; bulo masu kauri a gefe suna buƙatar bugawa sau biyu. Kana da rayuka 3. Sarari yana farawa ko tsayarwa.
ui.lib.arcade.note.connect4: Kana wasa da ja kuma kai ne ka fara. Taɓa ginshiƙi don jefa faifai; yana faɗuwa zuwa wurin da babu komai mafi ƙasa. Wanda ya fara jera faifai 4 a kwance, a tsaye ko a karkace shi ne ya ci nasara.
ui.lib.arcade.note.freecell: Dukkan katunan a buɗe suke. Matsar da dukkan katunan 52 zuwa tushe 4 bisa nau'i, daga A zuwa K. A kan tebur, jera ƙasa da launuka masu musanya. Kowace ƙofa marar komai a saman hagu tana riƙe kati ɗaya; yawan katunan da za ka iya matsarwa lokaci ɗaya ya dogara da ƙofofi marasa komai da ginshiƙai marasa komai. Matakai masu girma suna da ƙofofi kaɗan.
ui.lib.arcade.note.gomoku: Kana wasa da X kuma kai ne ka fara; kwamfuta tana wasa da O. Ku riƙa sanya alama a wurin da babu komai a allon 15×15. Wanda ya fara samun 5 a jere a kwance, a tsaye ko a karkace shi ne ya ci nasara.
ui.lib.arcade.note.klondike: Matsar da dukkan katunan 52 zuwa tushe 4 bisa nau'i, daga A zuwa K. A kan tebur, jera ƙasa da launuka masu musanya; K kaɗai ne zai iya shiga ginshiƙi marar komai. Taɓa tarin da ke kife a saman hagu don ɗaukar katuna. Taɓa kati sannan wurin da kake son sanya shi, ko ka sake taɓa shi don ya tafi da kansa zuwa wuri mai inganci. Matakai 1–5: ɗauki 1; matakai 6–10: ɗauki 3.
ui.lib.arcade.note.match3: Musanya guda biyu maƙwabta (taɓa ɗaya sannan ɗayan, ko goge) don yin layi na 3 ko fiye iri ɗaya; layin yana fashewa kuma gudan da ke sama suna faɗuwa. Martani na jere suna ninka makinka. Kai ga makin manufa kafin motsi ya ƙare.
ui.lib.arcade.note.minesweeper: Taɓa ƙofa don buɗe ta. Lamba tana nuna nakiyoyi nawa ne ke cikin ƙofofi 8 da ke kewaye da ita. Yi alamar nakiyar da kake zargi da danna dama, latsa na dogon lokaci ko yanayin tuta. Taɓa lamba wadda ke da isassun tutoci a kewaye don buɗe sauran da sauri. Buɗe dukkan ƙofofi marasa nakiya don cin nasara.
ui.lib.arcade.note.reversi: Kana wasa da baƙi kuma kai ne ka fara. Sanya faifai ta yadda zai kama faifai fari ɗaya ko fiye tsakaninsa da wani faifai baƙi (a kwance, a tsaye ko a karkace); faifan da aka kama suna juyawa zuwa launinka. Idan ba ka da motsi mai inganci, ka tsallake lokacinka. Idan allon ya cika, wanda ke da faifai mafi yawa ya ci nasara.
ui.lib.arcade.note.snake: Jagoranci maciji da maɓallan kibiya, WASD, maɓallan da ke ƙasa ko ta gogewa. Ci abinci ja don girma; kai ga tsawon da ake buƙata don wuce matakin. Daga mataki na 3, buga bango yana kawo ƙarshen wasan; matakai masu girma suna da cikas. Kada ka bugi wutsiyarka.
ui.lib.arcade.note.spider: A kan tebur, jera kowane nau'i a jere daga K zuwa ƙasa har A; cikakken jere na katuna 13 ana cire shi kai tsaye. Kowane kati zai iya hawa kan kati mafi girma da daraja ɗaya, amma jerin nau'i ɗaya kaɗai ke motsawa tare. Idan ka makale, taɓa Raba sabon jere (kowane ginshiƙi dole ya kasance yana da katuna). Matakai 1–3: nau'i ɗaya; 4–7: biyu; 8–10: huɗu.
ui.lib.arcade.shuffled: Babu sauran motsi — an sake gauraya allon.
ui.lib.arcade.noHintFc: Babu sauran motsi mai amfani. Soke wasu motsi ko sake farawa.

business.name: Kasuwanci a Intanet
business.desc: Kayan aiki don shagunan intanet, ƙananan kasuwanci da masu aikin kai-da-kai.

finance.name: Kuɗi da Lissafi
finance.desc: Ingantaccen lissafi bisa tsari da dokokin yanzu.

marketing.name: Tallace-tallace
marketing.desc: QR codes, hanyoyin haɗin yaƙin neman kasuwa da launukan alama.

life.name: Aiki da Rayuwa
life.desc: Kayan amfani na yau da kullum masu sauƙi.

health.name: Lafiya
health.desc: Bibiyi nauyi, abinci mai gina jiki, ruwa, motsa jiki da zagayen al'ada.

edu.name: Ilimi da Koyarwa
edu.desc: Jadawalin lokaci, tambayoyi, halarta, taswirar tunani da biyan kuɗi.

time.name: Kayan Aikin Lokaci
time.desc: Agogo, ƙirge lokaci, yankunan lokaci, ranakun aiki da littafin tarihin yau da kullum.

dev.name: Kayan Aikin Masu Haɓakawa
dev.desc: Tsara, bincika, ɓoye da sauya lambar tushe.

text.name: Kayan Aikin Rubutu
text.desc: Canja girman haruffa, rubutu masu ado don kafafen sada zumunta, rubutu zuwa murya da rubutu da murya.

calc.name: Masu Lissafi da Masu Sauyawa
calc.desc: Na'urar lissafi ta kimiyya, kashi-kashi da sauya raka'a.

device.name: Gwajin Na'ura
device.desc: Gwada kyamarar webcam ɗinka, rikodin allonka, auna saurin rubutu da danna a daƙiƙa.

media.name: Sauti da Bidiyo
media.desc: Matsa bidiyo, ciro sautin MP3 kuma daidaita guitar ɗinka a browser.

excel.name: Sarrafa Bayanan Excel
excel.desc: Cike Word daga Excel, haɗa cell, jera layuka da haɗa sheet ko fayilolin Excel da yawa da dabaru.

entertainment.name: Nishaɗi da Wasanni
entertainment.desc: Dabaran sa'a, lambobin bazuwar da wasannin burauza: Sudoku, dara, darar Sin, Gomoku, 2048, mai neman nakiya, tubalan da ke faɗuwa, maciji, solitaire da mai fasa bulo.

image-convert.name: Matsa Hoto
image-convert.desc: Rage girman fayil ɗin hoto kuma ƙanƙanta hotuna da yawa a lokaci ɗaya don saurin ɗora su a yanar gizo da imel.

image-format.name: Sauya Tsarin Hoto
image-format.desc: Sauya hotuna tsakanin JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP da ICO (favicon) don shafukan yanar gizo, manhajoji ko ajiya.

image-base64.name: Hoto zuwa Base64
image-base64.desc: Mayar da hotuna zuwa rubutun Base64 don saka su a HTML, CSS ko lamba, kuma ka mayar da Base64 zuwa hotuna.

bg-remove.name: Cire Bayan-fagen Hoto
bg-remove.desc: Cire farin bayan-fage ko na launi guda daga hotunan kayayyaki, tambura da hotunan bayanan martaba, nan take a na'urarka.

watermark.name: Sanya Alamar Mallaka a Hotuna
watermark.desc: Sanya rubutu, tambari ko alamar haƙƙin mallaka a hoto ɗaya ko hotuna da yawa a lokaci ɗaya.

pdf-merge.name: Haɗa da Raba PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Haɗa fayilolin PDF da yawa zuwa ɗaya, ciro shafukan da kake bukata, ko raba PDF shafi-shafi.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Sauya slides na PowerPoint (.pptx) zuwa PDF kuma ka mayar da fayilolin PDF zuwa PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Kwatanta Fayiloli Biyu
file-diff.desc: Nemo bambance-bambance tsakanin rubutu biyu: TXT, Word, HTML ko PDF mai rubutu. Ana haskaka sassan da aka ƙara, aka cire da aka canja.

text-analysis.name: Nazarin Rubutu
text-analysis.desc: Ƙirga kalmomi, haruffa, jimloli da sakin layi, ƙiyasta lokacin karatu da yawan kalmomin mabuɗi a rubutu, TXT, Word ko fayilolin PDF.

data-convert.name: Sauya JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Sauya bayanai tsakanin JSON, XML, CSV da Excel (.xlsx) tare da samfoti na tebur.

bmi-bmr.name: Mai Lissafin BMI da BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Lissafa ma'aunin nauyin jiki (BMI), rabon kugu-da-ƙugu da bukatar kalori (BMR, TDEE) bisa shekaru, jinsi da matakin motsa jiki.

meal-calo.name: Shirin Abinci da Kalori na Yau da Kullum
meal-calo.desc: Shirya abinci bisa burin kalori, duba kalori na abincin da aka saba da shi kuma daidaita furotin, carbohydrate da mai.

water-tracker.name: Mai Bibiyar Shan Ruwa
water-tracker.desc: Saita burin yau da kullum ka rubuta yawan ruwan da kake sha, tare da ci gaba da tarihin kwanaki da yawa.

calo-burn.name: Kalori da Aka Ƙona bisa Aiki
calo-burn.desc: Ƙiyasta kalori da aka ƙona bisa wasanni, aiki, tsawon lokaci da nauyin jiki ta amfani da ƙimar MET.

cycle-track.name: Mai Bibiyar Zagayen Al'ada
cycle-track.desc: Rubuta ka kuma hasashi zagayen al'adarka, ranar kwai da lokacin da za a iya ɗaukar ciki. Bayanai suna nan a na'urarka kawai.

study-timetable.name: Jadawalin Karatu
study-timetable.desc: Gina jadawalin darussa na mako-mako bisa lokutan darasi; buga shi ko ka ajiye shi don sake amfani kullum.

quiz-bank.name: Tambayoyi da Rumbun Tambayoyi
quiz-bank.desc: Ƙirƙiri rumbun tambayoyi masu zaɓi, gauraya tambayoyi, yi gwajin horo mai maki, ka buga jarrabawa da amsoshinta.

attendance.name: Halarta
attendance.desc: Gina jerin ɗalibai, ɗauki halarta a kowane zama kuma bibiyi rashin zuwa da jinkiri. Za a iya daidaita shi da Google Sheets.

mindmap.name: Taswirar Tunani da Taƙaitawa
mindmap.desc: Zana taswirar tunani don darussa kuma ka taƙaita dogon rubutu zuwa muhimman abubuwa kai tsaye.

teaching-pay.name: Sa'o'in Koyarwa da Biyan Kuɗi
teaching-pay.desc: Rubuta zaman koyarwa, ƙara sa'o'i da kuɗin biya bisa farashi, ka fitar da bayanin lissafi.

fullscreen-clock.name: Agogo Cikakken Allo
fullscreen-clock.desc: Babban agogon dijital na cikakken allo mai agogon gudu da ƙirge lokaci, launuka da rubutu da za a iya canzawa da tsarin awa 12/24.

countdown-video.name: Mai Yin Bidiyon Ƙirge Lokaci
countdown-video.desc: Ƙirƙiri na'urar ƙirge lokaci da za a iya keɓancewa ka sauke ta a matsayin bidiyo don sakawa cikin bidiyoyinka.

world-clock.name: Agogon Duniya
world-clock.desc: Duba lokacin yanzu a ƙasashe da yawa a lokaci ɗaya ka kwatanta bambancin yankunan lokaci tsakaninsu.

workdays.name: Mai Lissafin Ranakun Aiki
workdays.desc: Ƙirga ranakun aiki tsakanin kwanuka biyu, ban da Asabar, Lahadi da hutun jama'a.

journal.name: Littafin Tarihin Yau da Kullum a Intanet
journal.desc: Rubuta littafin tarihin yau da kullum da ake ajiyewa a asirce a Google Sheet naka, kai kaɗai za ka iya karanta shi.

code-format.name: Tsara JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Tsara lambar JavaScript, HTML, CSS da JSON da gindin layi da kyau.

code-check.name: Mai Duba Tsari
code-check.desc: Nemo kurakuran tsari da gini a JavaScript, HTML, CSS da JSON, tare da layi da ginshiƙi.

js-obfuscate.name: Mai Ɓoye JavaScript
js-obfuscate.desc: Sauya rubutu zuwa lamba, sake sunan maɓallai kuma ɓoye JavaScript don ya yi wuyar karantawa da kwafawa.

rsa-keys.name: Maɓallan RSA da Ɓoyewa
rsa-keys.desc: Samar da jerin maɓallan RSA (PEM), ɓoye rubutu da maɓallin jama'a ka buɗe da maɓalli na sirri, duka a na'urarka.

text-to-html.name: Rubutu Mai Tsari zuwa HTML
text-to-html.desc: Gyara a gani da rubutu mai kauri, kanun labarai, jeri, tebura da hanyoyin haɗi, ka sami lambar HTML mai tsabta.

inventory.name: Kaya da Farashi
inventory.desc: Saita farashin sayarwa bisa kuɗin kasuwa, tallace-tallace da riba. Bibiyi shigowa da fitar kaya tare da sanarwar ƙarancin kaya.

invoice.name: Daftari da Ƙiyasin Farashi
invoice.desc: Ƙirƙiri ƙiyasin farashi da daftarin sayarwa tare da tambari, jimillar kai tsaye da adadi da kalmomi. Buga ko ajiye a matsayin PDF.

menu-qr.name: Menu na QR
menu-qr.desc: Ƙirƙiri menu na dijital don gidajen abinci da wuraren shan shayi. Abokan ciniki suna duba QR code don ganin abinci da farashi.

barcode.name: Mai Ƙirƙirar Barcode
barcode.desc: Samar da barcode na Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A da Code 39 don lambobin kayayyaki da ɗakin ajiya.

loan.name: Mai Lissafin Rance
loan.desc: Biyan wata-wata, jimillar riba da jadawalin biyan bashi na rancen gida, mota da na amfani.

compound.name: Riba Mai Ninkawa da Ajiya
compound.desc: Hasashen abin da za ka tara da ajiya ko jari na wata-wata akai-akai.

salary.name: Albashi Gross ↔ Net
salary.desc: Sauya albashin Gross zuwa Net da akasin haka, bisa dokokin inshora da harajin kuɗin shiga na 2026 (Vietnam).

qr-code.name: Mai Ƙirƙirar QR Code
qr-code.desc: Ƙirƙiri QR codes na hanyoyin haɗi, rubutu, Wi-Fi, imel da lambobin waya. Sauke a matsayin PNG ko SVG.

utm.name: Mai Gina Hanyar Haɗin UTM
utm.desc: Ƙara lambobin bin diddigin yaƙin neman kasuwa a hanyoyin haɗi don ganin daga wace tasha baƙinka suke zuwa.

colors.name: Launuka da Lambobinsu
colors.desc: Gina jerin launuka masu jituwa daga launin tushe ka sami lambobin HEX, RGB, HSL da masu canjin CSS.

expense.name: Kashe Kuɗi da Kasafi
expense.desc: Rubuta kuɗin shiga da kashewa na yau da kullum, duba kashewa bisa rukuni kuma saita iyaka don ka tsaya a kasafi.

habit.name: Mai Bibiyar Dabi'a da Jeri
habit.desc: Yi alama a dabi'u kowace rana ka bibiyi jerin kwanaki a jere don ka kasance mai ladabtarwa.

cv.name: Mai Gina Takardar CV
cv.desc: Cike samfuri da samfoti kai tsaye, zaɓi tsari da launi, ka buga ko ajiye a matsayin PDF kyauta.

currency-time.name: Kuɗaɗe da Yankunan Lokaci
currency-time.desc: Sauya kuɗaɗe a sabbin farashi ka duba lokaci a birane na duniya.

image-resize.name: Mai Canja Girman Hoto
image-resize.desc: Canja girman hotuna bisa pixel ko kashi, kiyaye rabon faɗi da tsawo kuma sarrafa hotuna da yawa a lokaci ɗaya.

image-crop.name: Yanke Hoto
image-crop.desc: Yanke hotuna yadda kake so ko zuwa 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 da 9:16, ka juya ko ka jujjuya kafin saukewa.

image-ocr.name: Hoto zuwa Rubutu (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Ciro rubutu daga hotuna, hotunan allo da takardun da aka duba. Yana goyon bayan Turanci da wasu harsuna 30+.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC zuwa JPG
heic-jpg.desc: Sauya hotunan iPhone na HEIC zuwa JPG ko PNG don su buɗu a ko'ina. Ana goyon bayan sauya da yawa a lokaci ɗaya.

image-upscale.name: Mai Faɗaɗa Hoto na AI
image-upscale.desc: Faɗaɗa hotuna sau 2 ko 4 ka kaifafa bayanai da AI. Yana da kyau ga ƙananan hotuna, marasa haske ko tsofaffi.

image-to-pdf.name: Hoto zuwa PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Haɗa hotunan JPG da PNG zuwa PDF ɗaya, sake tsara shafuka ka zaɓi girman takarda da gefuna.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF zuwa Hoto
pdf-to-image.desc: Mayar da kowane shafin PDF zuwa JPG ko PNG mai kaifi, zaɓi ƙuduri, sauke hotuna ɗaya-ɗaya ko ZIP.

pdf-compress.name: Matsa PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Rage girman fayil ɗin PDF don imel da fom na intanet. Zaɓi matakin matsawa ka kwatanta girma.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF zuwa Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Sauya PDF zuwa fayil ɗin Word (.docx) da za a iya gyara tare da kiyaye rubutu da sakin layi, ko ka kiyaye tsarin shafi a matsayin hotuna.

word-to-pdf.name: Word zuwa PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Sauya fayilolin Word (.docx) zuwa PDF a browser naka, yi samfoti, sai ka sauke ko ka buga.

pdf-sign.name: Sa Hannu a PDF
pdf-sign.desc: Zana ko rubuta sa hannunka, ƙara sa hannun hoto da kwanan wata, sanya shi a shafukan PDF ka sauke.

pdf-edit.name: Gyara PDF da Cike Fom
pdf-edit.desc: Ƙara rubutu, alamun tabbatarwa da akwatunan ɓoyewa a PDF kuma cike filayen fom da ke akwai.

case-convert.name: Mai Canja Girman Haruffa
case-convert.desc: Sauya rubutu zuwa MANYAN HARUFFA, ƙananan haruffa, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case da ƙari.

fancy-text.name: Mai Ƙirƙirar Rubutu Mai Ado
fancy-text.desc: Mayar da rubutu na yau da kullum zuwa salon haruffa 30+ masu kyau don Instagram, TikTok, bayanan Facebook da sunayen wasa. Kwafa da taɓawa ɗaya.

text-to-speech.name: Rubutu zuwa Murya
text-to-speech.desc: Karanta rubutu da murya da muryoyin na'urarka. Zaɓi murya, gudu da sautin murya. Yana goyon bayan harsuna da yawa.

speech-to-text.name: Murya zuwa Rubutu
speech-to-text.desc: Rubuta da muryarka: yi magana a microphone ka ga rubutu yana bayyana nan take, sai ka kwafa ko ka sauke.

scientific-calc.name: Na'urar Lissafi ta Kimiyya
scientific-calc.desc: Na'urar lissafi ta intanet mai trigonometry, logarithm, ƙarfi, tushe, factorial, digiri/radian, ƙwaƙwalwa da tarihi.

percentage.name: Mai Lissafin Kashi
percentage.desc: Nemo X% na Y, kashi nawa X yake na Y, canjin kashi da farashin rangwame, tare da dabaru mataki-mataki.

unit-convert.name: Mai Sauya Raka'a
unit-convert.desc: Sauya tsawo, nauyi, zafin jiki, faɗin fili, ƙarar ruwa, gudu, lokaci, bayanai, matsi da kuzari.

age-calc.name: Mai Lissafin Shekaru
age-calc.desc: Lissafa ainihin shekaru a shekaru, watanni da kwanaki, jimillar kwanakin da aka yi rayuwa, ranar haihuwa mai zuwa da alamar taurari.

date-calc.name: Mai Lissafin Kwanan Wata
date-calc.desc: Ƙirga kwanaki tsakanin kwanuka biyu, ƙara ko cire kwanaki, makonni, watanni da shekaru, ka ga ranar mako.

gpa.name: Mai Lissafin GPA
gpa.desc: Lissafa GPA na zango da na gaba ɗaya bisa credit a ma'aunin 4.0 tare da darajar haruffa.

due-date.name: Mai Lissafin Ranar Haihuwa
due-date.desc: Ƙiyasta ranar haihuwa da makon ciki daga al'ada ta ƙarshe, ranar ɗaukar ciki ko ultrasound, tare da muhimman matakai.

spin-wheel.name: Juya Ƙafa
spin-wheel.desc: Yi ƙafa da kowane sunaye ko kyaututtuka, juya a bazuwar cikin adalci, cire waɗanda suka ci, yanayin cikakken allo.

random-number.name: Mai Samar da Lamba Bazuwar
random-number.desc: Samar da lambobi bazuwar a kowane iyaka, da yawa a lokaci ɗaya, tare da maimaitawa ko babu, don cacar baki da wasanni.

typing-test.name: Gwajin Saurin Rubutu
typing-test.desc: Auna saurin rubutunka (WPM) da daidaito cikin daƙiƙa 30 zuwa mintuna 5.

cps-test.name: Gwajin CPS (Saurin Danna)
cps-test.desc: Ƙirga dannawa a daƙiƙa cikin daƙiƙa 1 zuwa 60, ajiye mafi kyawun maki, gwada spacebar da taɓawa ma.

webcam-test.name: Gwajin Webcam
webcam-test.desc: Duba ko kyamararka tana aiki, ga ƙuduri da firam a daƙiƙa, canja kyamarori ka ɗauki hoton gwaji.

screen-recorder.name: Mai Rikodin Allo
screen-recorder.desc: Yi rikodin allonka, taga ko shafi tare da sautin tsarin da microphone, ba sai ka shigar da komai ba.

video-compress.name: Mai Matsa Bidiyo
video-compress.desc: Ƙanƙanta fayilolin MP4, MOV da WebM don aika saƙo, imel da kafafen sada zumunta. Zaɓi ƙuduri da inganci.

video-to-mp3.name: Bidiyo zuwa MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Ciro sauti daga bidiyon MP4, MOV da WebM a matsayin MP3, zaɓi inganci ka yanke ɓangaren da kake bukata.

guitar-tuner.name: Mai Daidaita Guitar
guitar-tuner.desc: Daidaita guitar, ukulele da bass da microphone naka: nota, bambancin cents da allura, tare da sautunan tunani.

password-gen.name: Mai Samar da Kalmar Sirri
password-gen.desc: Ƙirƙiri kalmomin sirri masu ƙarfi bazuwar ko jimlolin sirri masu sauƙin tunawa, zaɓi tsawo da haruffa, duba ƙarfi.

signature.name: Mai Yin Sa Hannu
signature.desc: Zana sa hannunka da linzamin kwamfuta ko yatsa, ko ka rubuta shi da rubutun hannu; sauke PNG mai bayyanawa.

logo-maker.name: Mai Yin Tambari
logo-maker.desc: Yi tambari daga alama, sunan kamfani da taken kalma; zaɓi rubutu, launuka da tsari, sauke SVG ko PNG.

notepad.name: Littafin Rubutu na Intanet
notepad.desc: Gajerun bayanai da ake ajiyewa kai tsaye a browser naka: bayanai da yawa, bincike, ƙirga kalmomi da saukewar TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Cike Word daga Excel
excel-word-fill.desc: Ɗauki abun ciki daga fayil na Excel ka saka shi a alamomin fayil na Word, tare da nuna lambobin taken da ja.

excel-cell-merge.name: Haɗa Cell na Excel daga Sheet / Fayiloli da yawa
excel-cell-merge.desc: Haɗa cell ɗaya (A1, B2...) daga sheet ko fayilolin Excel da yawa zuwa ɗaya, tare da gargaɗi ga cell da ke da bayanai a tushe fiye da ɗaya.

excel-row-concat.name: Jera Layukan Excel daga Sheet / Fayiloli da yawa
excel-row-concat.desc: Jera sheet ko fayilolin Excel da yawa a tsaye zuwa tebur guda mai tsawo. Bar layin kai sau ɗaya kuma cire layuka marasa komai.

excel-formula-merge.name: Haɗa Bayanan Excel da Dabaru
excel-formula-merge.desc: Haɗa sheet ko fayilolin Excel da yawa da dabara a kowane cell (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), ayyuka cikin juna, da dabarun da aka adana waɗanda za ka iya sake amfani da su.

sudoku-9x9.name: Sudoku 9x9
sudoku-9x9.desc: Yi wasan Sudoku 9x9 a intanet a matakai 10 daga sauƙi zuwa wuya, tare da bayanan kula, manuniya da duba kurakurai.

sudoku-16x16.name: Sudoku 16x16
sudoku-16x16.desc: Babban Sudoku 16x16 mai 1-9 da A-G, matakai 10 daga sauƙi zuwa wuya, tare da bayanan kula da manuniya.

chess.name: Dara
chess.desc: Yi wasan dara da kwamfuta a matakai 10 ko a kan layi: gayyaci aboki da mahaɗi ko ka yi wasa da sabon mutum. Tare da castling, en passant da ɗaukaka.

xiangqi.name: Xiangqi (dara ta Sin)
xiangqi.desc: Yi wasan Xiangqi da kwamfuta a matakai 10 ko a kan layi: gayyaci aboki da mahaɗi ko ka yi wasa da sabon mutum. Cikakkun dokoki: ƙafar doki, idon giwa, tsallen igwa da janar da ba za su ga juna ba.

go-game.name: Go
go-game.desc: Yi wasan Go da kwamfuta a matakai 10 ko a kan layi a allunan 9x9, 13x13 da 19x19 tare da aboki ko sabon abokin hamayya. Ƙidaya ta atomatik a ƙarshe.

memory-shapes.name: Ƙwaƙwalwar Siffa & Launi
memory-shapes.desc: Ana nuna tayal masu siffofi da launuka na daƙiƙa 5 sannan a ɓoye; haddace ka zaɓi tayal ɗin da ya dace, matakai 10 daga sauƙi zuwa wuya.

snake.name: Maciji
snake.desc: Jagoranci maciji don ya ci ya girma ba tare da ya bugi bango ko wutsiyarsa ba; matakai 10 masu sauri da cikas.

solitaire.name: Solitaire

rsa-keys.note: Komai yana gudana a browser naka ta Web Crypto kuma ba a taɓa aika shi ko'ina ba. Saboda RSA yana iya ɓoye gajerun bayanai ne kawai kai tsaye, kayan aikin yana amfani da ɓoyewa mai haɗaka: yana samar da maɓallin AES bazuwar don ɓoye rubutun, sa'an nan ya naɗe maɓallin AES da RSA — don haka ana iya ɓoye rubutu na kowane tsawo. Mai karɓa yana buƙatar maɓalli na sirri da ya dace don buɗewa. Ana iya raba maɓallin jama'a (SPKI); dole a ɓoye maɓalli na sirri (PKCS#8).

typing-test.texts: Kowace safiya ina tashi da wuri in yi gudu a kusa da tafki. Iska mai daɗi tana share min kai kuma tana shirya ni don sabuwar rana a wurin aiki. Bayan haka sai in ci karin kumallo tare da iyalina, in karanta shafuka kaɗan na littafi, sannan in fara aikina. Ƙananan dabi'u da ake maimaitawa kullum suna taruwa su kawo manyan canje-canje a tsawon lokaci.|Najeriya tana da yanayin ƙasa iri-iri, daga rairayin bakin teku masu rana na Legas zuwa tsaunukan Jos masu sanyi. Matafiya na iya ziyartar dutsen Zuma da ke kusa da Abuja, su ji daɗin kiɗa da raye-raye na Kano, ko su yi yawo a kasuwannin Ibadan masu cunkoso. Kowane yanki yana da nasa ɗabi'a.|Koyon rubutu da yatsu goma fasaha ce mai amfani ga duk wanda yake aiki da kwamfuta. Idan ka saba da shi, ba sai ka kalli allon maɓalli ba, saurin rubutunka yana ƙaruwa kuma kana yin kurakurai kaɗan. Yi atisaye na kimanin minti goma sha biyar kowace rana, ka mai da hankali kan daidaito tukuna, sannan ka ƙara sauri a hankali.
